guarantees.claim: All listed control and status signals are driven combinationally from the corresponding bits of in_buf in the order shown in the concatenation.
op is driven as the ciph_op_e enum value corresponding to the raw bit pattern of op_raw.

assumptions.claim: in_buf width exactly matches the sum of widths of all signals listed in the concatenation so that no truncation or zero-padding changes the bit-to-signal mapping.
assumptions.cond: when in_buf is sampled or changes
assumptions.risk: bit misalignment could cause critical fields (crypt, key_clear, alert_fatal, etc.) to receive wrong values, enabling unintended operations or security bypass.

assumptions.claim: op_raw always holds a valid ciph_op_e encoding; out-of-bounds values never occur.
assumptions.risk: an illegal op value may cause the FSM to follow an out-of-bounds transition, potentially bypassing essential security sequences (e.g., key clearing) or entering a deadlock.

uncertain_points.claim: The combinatorial assignment exposes all control and status fields to glitches if in_buf is not a stable registered signal.
uncertain_points.cond: when in_buf changes asynchronously or glitches
uncertain_points.risk: glitches on sensitive signals like key_clear, data_out_clear, crypt, or alert_fatal could momentarily trigger dangerous actions (e.g., key wipe, false alert) or corrupt state.

uncertain_points.claim: No local check ensures op_raw lies within the valid enum range; the cast will produce an out-of-bounds op if op_raw is illegal.
uncertain_points.cond: when op_raw holds an illegal value
uncertain_points.risk: the downstream FSM may misinterpret the undefined op as a valid command, leading to unauthorized operations (e.g., exposure or mismanagement of secret data).

uncertain_points.claim: sub_bytes_out_req and key_expand_out_req are driven from in_buf but their usage is not visible in this chunk; they may be dead or only for debug.
uncertain_points.risk: if unused, they represent dead logic and could hide missing functional connectivity or unnecessary toggling.
